Square With Upper Right To Lower Left Fill Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Square With Upper Right To Lower Left Fill because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+25A8, which you can use as ▨ in HTML, \25A8 in CSS, or type with Alt+9640 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Square With Upper Right To Lower Left Fill is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+25A8 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Square With Upper Right To Lower Left Fill has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ▨ or the hex escape ▨.

How to type square with upper right to lower left fill on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 6 4 0 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 9640.
  4. Release Alt. The Square With Upper Right To Lower Left Fill character (▨) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type square with upper right to lower left fill on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Square With Upper Right To Lower Left Fill. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Square With Upper Right To Lower Left Fill" and click the character to insert it.

How to use square with upper right to lower left fill in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\25A8"; ()
  • Python: \u25A8 or chr(0x25A8)
  • JavaScript: \u25A8 or String.fromCodePoint(0x25A8)
  • JSON: "\u25A8"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ▨?

No legacy Alt code exists for Square With Upper Right To Lower Left Fill because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+25A8 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ▨ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ▨, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9640 not work?

Alt+9640 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Square With Upper Right To Lower Left Fill?

The Unicode codepoint for Square With Upper Right To Lower Left Fill is U+25A8. You can use this value in HTML as ▨, in CSS as \25A8, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ▨ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+25A8, then click it.
